name: Scout Support
summary: South of Tarren Mill, you carry new orders from High Executor Darthalia to Deathstalker Masoj. The Forsaken press on with their plan to take control of these lands.

sections.title: Orders for Masoj
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia trusts you with word for the forward spies. She gives you updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj, who waits on high ground north of Nethander Stead and outside Dun Garok. The Forsaken plan to take control of these lands continues, and Masoj is waiting for your delivery.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia gave you updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj.
Deathstalker Masoj is a forward spy posted outside Dun Garok, north of Nethander Stead.
Masoj waits south of Tarren Mill, on high ground north of Nethander Stead and outside Dun Garok.

faq.q: What am I carrying to Masoj?
faq.answer: You carry updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj.
Your delivery supports the Forsaken plan to take control of these lands.
